species.PRIMITIVE: Bounded operation/helper with direct technical reuse; not product maturity.
species.PATTERN: Proven composition/architecture law; usually no package identity.
species.CAPABILITY_BLOCK: User-meaningful product capability with Passport, boundaries and independent proof.
species.SHARED_SERVICE: Reusable substrate not itself a product outcome.

edge_types.PROVIDES: Block exposes a versioned product contract/Port.
edge_types.REQUIRES: Composition must resolve this dependency or stop at a gap.
edge_types.OPTIONALLY_USES: Dependency may be absent only with explicit safe absence behaviour.
edge_types.BRIDGED_BY: Provider/integration implementation selected for a Port.
edge_types.COMPOSED_WITH: Exact versions have succeeded together in a verified Oros composition.
edge_types.CONSUMED_BY: Exact Block specimen is consumed by an Oros.
edge_types.OBSERVED_BY_STAR: Operational signals enter an Oros Star domain.
edge_types.SUPERSEDES: Version lineage; old evidence remains history.

authority_flow.Factory: resolves exact eligible Block and Bridge versions and verifies composition
authority_flow.oros.lock: records exact actual composition; no authority
authority_flow.Micro-Constellation: bounded governed projection over one Oros
authority_flow.Star: managed operational domain over 0..N Blocks/services/product-specific modules

laws: no silent upgrade or consumer fork
product-specific glue is allowed and must stay explicit
training primitives remain valuable even when not Capability Blocks
